hospital: Memorial Healthcare System (Memorial Regional Hospital, Hollywood FL)
title: Financial Assistance Policy, Revised May 2026

insured-balances.quote: This means all uninsured patient responsibility amounts as well as insured patient balances after insurance payment. This includes deductibles, coinsurance, copayments, and non-covered charges.

min-request.quote: The amount of the requested financial assistance must be more than $500, for all accounts combined.

tier-200.quote: has a total household income of less than or equal to 200% of the FPG

liquid-assets.quote: The Patient or responsible party has household liquid assets less than $10,000.

scale.quote: Patient or responsible party has a total household income of between 201% and 400%

income-cap.quote: At no point will a patient who qualifies for financial assistance be responsible for more than 10% of their annual total household income.

prior-accounts.quote: When MHS approves financial assistance for a Patient or responsible party, MHS will also consider accounts incurred within the prior twelve months.

window.quote: Patients or responsible parties can apply for financial assistance for up to one year after the date of service or twelve months after last insurance payment.

facilities-only.quote: This Financial Assistance Policy only applies to services provided by MHS at its facilities and services provided by MHS employed physicians.
